subject: Solara Health — executive recap: outcomes, risks, and procurement checklist
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Solara Health — executive recap: outcomes, risks, and procurement checklist

Aisha / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our sponsor briefing so your leadership can share internally. I captured the key business outcomes you mentioned, the main risks we surfaced, and a pragmatic procurement path so legal/procurement have a playbook.

High-level outcomes (metrics of success)
- Reduce end-to-end triage latency by 40% for claims processing (target: p95 under 400ms)
- 20% reduction in manual review volume via model-assisted routing
- Pilot goal: validate throughput at 10k inference/day with parity on accuracy vs. current baseline

Primary pain points discussed
- Latency spikes during batch hours (9–11am PT) causing timeouts in downstream systems
- Auditability: need immutable request logs and per-request tracing for regulated audits
- Data residency: pilot must store logs only in US regions; enterprise will require additional controls

Operational risks we flagged
- Integration: KV/cache warming on live traffic will need a short ramp to avoid cold-start penalties
- Security evidence: SOC 2 + architecture diagrams required for procurement to advance
- Contracting: indemnity/procurement SLA terms will be discussed during the enterprise phase

Proposed procurement path (recommended cadence)
1) Pilot (6–8 weeks): limited scope (claims routing), defined success criteria, NDA in place —> Redwood provides pilot SOW and SOC2 evidence pack. (owner: Redwood Sales / Rachel)
2) Pilot evaluation (2 weeks): joint runbook and short eval report (owner: Solara & Redwood)
3) Enterprise contract negotiation: standard Redwood terms, SLA addendum and data residency appendix (owner: Solara procurement / Tom Hale + Redwood Legal)

Immediate next steps (owners & timelines)
- Rachel: send consolidated SOW draft and SOC2 evidence outline (today) — attachment: SOW-solara-pilot-v1.pdf, SOC2-evidence-outline.docx
- Tom: confirm procurement legal contact and preferred contracting timeline (by Fri, 18 Dec)
- Karthik: provide capacity & pricing snapshot for a 6–8 week pilot (by Wed, 16 Dec)
- Marcus: coordinate an infra deep-dive (30–45 min) with Solara infra team to validate p95 latency target (schedule for next week)

Open questions (for Solara leadership)
- Any existing upload/ingest throttles we should know about (S3 presigned behavior or API rate-limits)?
- Will logs for the pilot be permitted to live in a Redwood-managed US-only bucket?

Attachments: SOW-solara-pilot-v1.pdf (draft), SOC2-evidence-outline.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-minute sync if helpful.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference that scales
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@solarahealth.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@solarohealth.com>, Tom Hale <tom.hale@solarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solara Health — executive recap: outcomes, risks, and procurement checklist

Rachel — great summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side and a couple of names to loop in: 

1) Procurement/legal: Tom Hale (copied) is our procurement lead; he will be the point for contracting cadence. Tom, we generally operate on a 4–6 week review window for pilot SOWs depending on volume — will confirm on Friday.
2) Infra: our infra alias is infra@solarahealth.com (I included Marcus on the thread but Marcus's address above is internal; I also cc'd our infra alias below).
3) Data residency: Pilot logs in US-only buckets are acceptable, but for enterprise we will need an audit trail that can be exported to our internal GCP org. Need to validate export format.
4) SOC2: Can you send a short table of the SOC2 attestations and whether you have the auditor report available for redaction? That will speed risk sign-off.

Proposed timeline:
- Dec 14: receive SOW draft and SOC2 evidence (Rachel)
- Dec 16–17: infra deep-dive sync (Marcus + infra@solarahealth.com)
- Dec 18: Tom to confirm contracting path / timeline

Happy to run a 20-minute exec review next Tuesday if it helps unblock procurement quickly.

On the cold-start notes — yes, we have an internal spike between 09:00–11:30 PT driven by upstream batches; anything we can do to pre-warm would be valuable.

Thanks,
Aisha
VP, Clinical Ops — Solara Health
aisha@solarahealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@solarahealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solara Health — executive recap: outcomes, risks, and procurement checklist

Hi Aisha / Rachel — quick technical + commercial clarifications after reviewing the pilot scope.

Technical
- Pilot capacity: we can provision a dedicated pilot pool sized for ~10k inference/day with burst headroom to 20k. We'll include KV cache warm strategies (pre-warm scripts and a short ramp plan) in the infra deep-dive.
- Audit logs: Redwood can provide append-only per-request logs with export to an S3/GCS bucket you control; for enterprise we can add streaming to your GCP org. We just need a destination bucket and role to push.

Commercial
- Pricing snapshot (ballpark for pilot): $12k–$18k for a 6-week pilot depending on throughput/burst needs and retention window for logs. We'll solidify after the infra call.
- SOW timing: I've attached a pilot SOW template (in the shared drive link Rachel sent) — legal typically needs ~3–4 weeks for pilot SOW redline, enterprise contract could take 4–8 weeks depending on terms.

Next steps I will take now
- Share a short pre-warm script + ramp plan before the infra deep-dive
- Prepare an internal one-page pricing sheet for the pilot (EOD Wed)

Thanks — copying Marcus to coordinate the infra sync.

Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
